issue.title: Add a native read-only / planning permission mode (enforceable via agent-commander --read-only)

requirements.text: Re-add OpenCode's permission system in the most similar way possible
Default behavior remains full auto-mode (no behavior change)
Plan, readonly, and approve-each-command via CLI options
Fully controllable from JSON (input and output), no TUI
Detailed docs on how to send approval JSON
Fail clearly if the mode cannot be honored
Implement in both JavaScript and Rust
Case study folder with deep analysis, research, requirements, solution plans

priorArt.name: OpenCode
priorArt.facts: Three actions allow/ask/deny; per-tool bash/edit/webfetch; bash string or {pattern:action}; last-matching-rule-wins; HTTP POST /session/:id/permissions/:permissionID with {response: once|always|reject, remember?}; permission.updated SSE event.

priorArt.name: Claude Code
priorArt.facts: --permission-mode plan; canUseTool / --permission-prompt-tool MCP returns {behavior: 'allow'|'deny', updatedInput?, message?}; permissions.{allow,ask,deny,defaultMode}; Bash(git log:*) rule syntax.

priorArt.name: MCP elicitation
priorArt.facts: elicitation/create with requestedSchema; response action accept|decline|cancel (three-action model).

priorArt.name: Gemini CLI / Qwen Code
priorArt.facts: --approval-mode plan|default|auto_edit|yolo; tool allowlist in plan mode.

priorArt.name: Vercel AI SDK 6
priorArt.facts: needsApproval per-tool flag; in-process JS-only, not a JSON transport, not cross-language.
